work_item: W85 ambiguous body scope and stale explicit-color owner audit
scope: Read-only route audit plus isolated candidate/test only. No installed source, HTML, mirrors, Wiki, paint kernel, provider, native app, or renderer changes.

frozen_fresh_oracle.stale_roof_hood_case: Make the roof and hood red.

pro_ai.change: queueEditZones atomically refuses a requested part when an existing exact edit-key owner is stale/unproved, before any add/edit callbacks run. It does not adopt a replacement zone.

pro_design.change: offlinePart refuses relative extent/body aliases (upper/lower/top/bottom/front/rear/back portions) that the existing `body` whole-car token could otherwise broaden. Explicit whole-car wording remains available.

checks: Ran actual offlineAskCore, offlinePartAsk/offlineCoveredPartAsk, D/E planning and queueEditZones bodies with controlled tool callbacks.

All 9 frozen ambiguous extent/body requests queue zero under the candidate. Baseline `Make the upper body blue` queued region {everything:true}; front-body aliases also broadened to the whole car; upper-side requests expanded to full left/right sides.
Whole-car blue/red and supplemental `Make everything blue` remain explicit positive controls, queuing region {everything:true}.

Baseline stale roof+hood recolor queues two adds (hood and roof), each with finish `base::gloss`; candidate queues zero because the existing roof owner is stale and the request cannot be safely completed as a whole.
W79 producer contract rerun against candidate proAI: 12/12 PASS_WITH_LIMITS, including allowed unrelated/opposite-side/explicit-color controls.
Node syntax checks passed for both candidate modules and test.

limits: Harness exercises real routing/planner/queue functions but mocks source identity, existing zone state and add/edit handlers; no mutation is applied or rendered and no mask overlap is measured.
Stale-owner case uses a prior-provenance/current-generation mismatch fixture; no real failed PSD load is performed.
`Make everything chrome` is unsupported by the exercised offline part-color route and safely queues nothing; it is not counted as a positive whole-car control.
The candidate is isolated and is not installed. W80/current parent integration work was not merged into this candidate; parent must reconcile changes before any promotion.
The route's known supported-part vocabulary remains limited; this does not add vehicle geometry or car-recognition semantics.
